description: This file defines a CartProvider class for managing shopping cart items in a Flutter application, including methods to add, remove, and clear cart items, and to calculate total cost.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the list of cart items, providing methods to add, remove, clear items, and compute total price.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds seats for an event to the cart, merging seats if the event already exists in the cart.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific seat from the cart for a given event.
